entries.rawContent: Wrapping up the redesign discussion — here's where we landed.
Decision: shipping the new onboarding flow with a 3-step wizard. We tested 5-step and 2-step in usability sessions and 3-step had the highest completion rate. Locking it in.
Decision #2: defaulting new accounts to the 'team' tier, not 'solo'. The data shows 71% of trial-to-paid conversions upgrade to team within 30 days anyway — leading with team reduces a friction step.

Insight worth saving: the biggest unlock from the user interviews was that founders don't think about 'departments' as a concept — they think about 'who's doing what'. Our taxonomy fights that. We should reframe departments as 'pods' or 'teams' in the v2 nav.

Reference: pulled this Pendo benchmark for SaaS onboarding completion — https://pendo.io/benchmarks/onboarding-2024 — the 3-step finding actually matches their cross-customer median. Worth bookmarking.

expected.rubric: Pass when the actual extracted candidates contain at least 2 items of type 'decision' (the 3-step onboarding wizard, the team-tier default), at least 1 item of type 'insight' (the founders-don't-think-in-departments framing), and at least 1 item of type 'reference' (the Pendo benchmark link). Extra items are fine if they capture real content from the thread. Score 1.0 on clean pass (all four required types/counts present), 0.7 if 3 of 4 required signals present, 0.4 if 2 of 4, 0.0 if 0 or 1.
